name: LOL-EVE-TFBS-Benchmark
description: Benchmark for predicting transcription factor binding sites (TFBS) from DNA sequences, assessing models' ability to classify sequence regions as bound or unbound across factors and genomic contexts. Designed to evaluate sequence-based models that incorporate evolutionary information and local sequence features for TFBS prediction.
reputation: A niche research benchmark from the Marks-lab focused on TFBS prediction; modest adoption within genomics method-development communities.
